diagnosis.conclusion: The campaign could not mature under its own execution-quality policy because the fixed simulated fee alone was 150 bps at EUR 100 reference notional; adding the deterministic 5 bps PAPER slippage produced about 155 bps. This was a calibration defect in the validation probe economics, not evidence of market execution quality.

disposition.nextAction: Start a fresh PAPER campaign from a new immutable baseline after correcting probe sizing, candidate rotation and fingerprint coverage.
